blocks.text: Architectural facade design for a villa renovation in Marbella, Spain

parts.html: The architectural facade design for a luxury villa in Marbella, Spain, was developed by DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) as part of a renovation project.

The goal was to update the existing exterior, preserving the building’s proportions while giving it a contemporary, elegant look. The villa’s character is emphasized by the facade materials, architectural details, and color combinations.
The villa’s new look is shown in photorealistic 3D visualizations and a 3D tour, so the facade, finishing materials, and colors can be assessed before the renovation begins.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — we create architecture that inspires.
